text:
Micah Lee: dropping thoughts from the design review—main focus: making region fallback & KMS state explicit in audit rows. screenshot in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/compliance-audit-v4 :mag:
Noor Ahmed: saw it. first thing: fallback info is hidden behind the details chevron. suggestion: surface a small gray microlabel on the row: 'served from fallback region'.
Gabe Torres: agree. microlabel needs hover text that explains why: 'Fallback used when primary region unavailable; may route data via US infra.' link to policy.
Lina Park: accessibility: that microlabel must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-describedby linking to the info dialog. don't rely on hover alone.
Micah Lee: also KMS badge wording: current 'BYOK' is shorthand and confusing. propose badge text: 'Customer key (BYOK)' and 'Redwood key' — keep it max 2 words on pill.
Noor Ahmed: tooltips expand on hover: 'Customer key (BYOK): key stored in customer's KMS. Redwood never stores the raw key.' and 'Redwood key: managed by Redwood; see key policy.'
Gabe Torres: export CSV should include both the human-readable KMS label and an enum field kms_type (redwood | customer | none). makes downstream audits easier.
Lina Park: visual contrast: the fallback microlabel gray is currently 45% contrast; bump to pass 4.5:1. also use a left border accent rather than only color to avoid color-only cues.
Micah Lee: row density tradeoff: for compact mode we should hide the long event description and show a one-line summary with 'Show details' button (keyboard accessible) that expands in-place. aria-live should announce 'Details shown' when expanded.
Noor Ahmed: copy nit for audit messages: change 'User action recorded' -> 'Action recorded by {actor}' for clarity. and for system events, prefix with 'System:' so reviewers know it's automated.
Gabe Torres: note on timestamps: when collapsing traces we lose per-subevent timestamps. retain them in the collapsed tooltip/list so forensic reviewers can see ordering.
Lina Park: keyboard flow: expand buttons are currently after the right-side action icons. Move expand to be the first actionable element in the row to simplify tabbing. maintain logical reading order for screen readers.
Micah Lee: retention change UX: when lowering retention (destructive), show confirm modal with explicit consequences line: 'Data older than X days will be permanently deleted.' include a copyable policy id in the modal for audit trails.
Noor Ahmed: toast accessibility: make retention toasts aria-live='polite' and include the policy name + scope: e.g., 'Retention policy "Embeddings - 90 days" applied to org: Acme (EU-west)'.
Gabe Torres: CSV header suggestion for exports: 'Event Time','Actor','Event','Regions (codes)','Regions (labels)','KMS Type','Policy ID' — duplicates help both machine parsers and humans.
Lina Park: small CSS ask: the 1px row divider looks broken at certain zoom levels. use 2px or hairline + background gradient to avoid artifacting.
console-bot: preview-upload: compliance-audit-v4 by @Micah Lee  preview: https://staging.redwood.app/compliance/audit/v4 (expires 48h) :rocket:
Micah Lee: i'll update the figma with badge text, microlabel treatment, export header list, and the confirm copy. thanks for the quick feedback, leaving open for any final microcopy tweaks.
Noor Ahmed: one last: in API docs, make sure the audit endpoint includes fields: regions[], served_from_fallback: boolean, kms_type, policy_id — avoids mapping ambiguity.
Gabe Torres: logged a short dev task to keep virtualization for compact mode and to keep timestamps in collapsed summaries.
Lina Park: will run a quick screenreader pass on the preview build tomorrow morning and post notes. :wave:
